verdict.rationale: Browserbase's agent platform says it can 'process downloaded content such as PDFs and spreadsheets', and the Downloads API retrieves files from hosted sessions, so some hosted handling of PDFs and spreadsheets is evidenced. Nothing shows actual text-extraction output, and Word and PowerPoint are never mentioned. The URL-to-markdown fetch covers web pages, not office documents. Missing for 10: explicit text-extraction capability for documents, Word (.docx) support, PowerPoint (.pptx) support, documented extraction quality/output format, independent or hands-on corroboration.
